UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated neighbor profile, block membership pointer, Pro Alerts settings, and passive earnings ledger.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

activeCircleName.description: Display name of the active BlockCircle.

activeInviteCode.description: Invite code of the active BlockCircle.

completedHandoffs.description: Total completed tool rentals and micro-jobs.

onTimeReturns.description: Count of on-time tool returns and jobs.

totalFeesSavedOrPaidCents.description: Cumulative 5% micro-escrow fees processed in cents.

proAlertsEnabled.description: Whether BlockBench Pro Alerts tier is active.

alertRadiusMiles.description: Pro Alert watch radius in miles.

alertCategories.description: Watched listing categories for Pro Alerts.

BlockCircle.title: BlockCircle
BlockCircle.description: Verified hyper-local residential block circle uniting neighbors within a few streets.

creatorUid.description: UID of the neighbor who created the circle.

inviteCode.description: Invite code: 4-12 uppercase letters and digits. New codes are 8 characters (3 from the name, 5 random).

memberUids.description: Member UIDs (max 50). The creator is always a member; other neighbors add and remove only themselves.

CircleInvite.title: CircleInvite
CircleInvite.description: Single-document lookup record keyed by uppercase invite code.

inviteCode.description: Uppercase invite code matching the document ID.

circleName.description: Display name of the target circle.

Listing.title: Listing
Listing.description: Peer-to-peer tool rental or hyper-local micro-job posted inside a BlockCircle. Readable by the current members of that circle.

ownerUid.description: UID of the neighbor who posted the listing.

ownerName.description: Display name of the listing owner.

kind.description: Whether listing is a lendable tool or micro-job.

description.description: Detailed tool specs or micro-job instructions.

category.description: Craft category tag (e.g. Power Tools, Yard Care, Quick Fix).

rateCents.description: Rental rate or job payout in cents.

depositCents.description: Refundable security deposit in cents (always 0 for micro-jobs).

instantPickup.description: True if ready for immediate porch pickup or claim.

photoUri.description: Empty, or a small JPEG thumbnail stored inline as a data:image/jpeg;base64 URI (max 60000 characters). Never a link.

status.description: Current listing availability. 'reserved' exactly while activeBookingId names an unsettled booking.

activeBookingId.description: ID of the booking currently holding this listing, or empty. Set and cleared in the same write as the booking.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Auditable micro-escrow hold and handoff record between requester and provider. Created by the neighbor who books; the listing owner approves and confirms completion. Never deleted.

requesterUid.description: UID of the neighbor who pays: the borrower of a tool, or the poster of a micro-job.

providerUid.description: UID of the neighbor who earns: the lender of a tool, or the worker on a micro-job.

grossAmountCents.description: Rental or job rate in cents, copied from the listing.

platformFeeCents.description: 5% micro-escrow platform fee in cents, rounded half up.

providerNetCents.description: Net payout to provider in cents (grossAmountCents - platformFeeCents).

notes.description: Pickup porch code or handoff note.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated neighbor profile, Pro Alerts config, and passive earnings summary.

/circles/{circleId}.description: Verified neighborhood block circles scoped to memberUids.

/circleInvites/{inviteCode}.description: Exact-code invite lookup documents (get allowed, list denied).

/listings/{listingId}.description: Tools and micro-jobs visible to members of the same BlockCircle; query with circleId == <circle>.

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Micro-escrow bookings scoped strictly to participantUids.
